diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: The sector S={r e^{iθ}:r>0, −π/4<θ<π/4} is sent biholomorphically by z↦z² onto {w∈C: Re w>0}; the verification doubles the argument interval to (−π/2,π/2).
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: complex-plane domain map with angle rays
diagram_candidates.reason: The domain and image are both planar regions, and the proof hinges on how the two boundary rays map and how the argument interval doubles. A paired domain/image sketch makes the correspondence immediately checkable.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show source rays at −π/4 and π/4 with an interior point z=re^{iθ}; show their images under z² at −π/2 and π/2 and the right half-plane interior, preserving the positive orientation and radius map r↦r².
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain editorial candidate; source supports every component, but diagram is optional.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: S={z:−π/2<Re z<π/2, Im z>0}; sin(π/2+iy)=cosh y, sin(−π/2+iy)=−cosh y, and sin x∈(−1,1) on the bottom edge, so the boundary maps to R and the interior to H.
diagram_candidates.reason: The map sends three distinct boundary pieces of a half-strip onto the two exterior real rays and the interval [−1,1], so a boundary map sketch helps check the split and signs.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw the vertical boundary x=π/2 mapping to [1,∞), x=−π/2 mapping to (−∞,−1], and bottom y=0 mapping monotonically to [−1,1]; mark the upper-half-plane image and boundary endpoints.
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain editorial candidate; formulas and image claim are source-supported.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: For 0<Im z<π, Φ(z)=(e^z−i)/(e^z+i) is C∘e^z from the strip to the unit disc; e^z maps into H and C maps H biholomorphically to D.
diagram_candidates.reason: The theorem is explicitly a two-stage map with different domains and image boundaries; a diagram can make the intermediate half-plane and boundary behavior concrete.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Show strip edges Im z=0 and π mapping under exp to positive and negative real rays, respectively; then show the Cayley map taking the real line to the unit circle and H to D, with arrows labeled exp and C. Verify edge endpoints/limits at 0 and infinity.
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain editorial candidate; proposed boundary mapping follows the source formula.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: The keyhole path uses upper radial r→R, outer circle counterclockwise, lower radial R→r, and inner circle clockwise; its integral is the signed sum of the four oriented piece integrals. The parametrizations are r+(R−r)t, Re^{2πit}, R−(R−r)t, re^{2πi(1−t)}.
diagram_candidates.reason: Direction and signs are central to the example, and a keyhole sketch can reveal an orientation or endpoint mismatch at a glance.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw the positive-real-axis branch cut, radii r and R, upper/lower radial arrows, outer CCW arrow, inner CW arrow, and the four joining endpoints in traversal order; verify the listed parametrizations match those arrows.
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain editorial candidate; parametrizations and orientations are explicit source claims.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: With p=(a+b)/2, q=(b+c)/2, r=(c+a)/2, the triangle integral equals the sum on [a,p,r], [p,b,q], [r,q,c], [p,q,r]; the proof cancels the three oppositely oriented shared edges.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: triangle midpoint subdivision with oriented edges
diagram_candidates.reason: The identity is entirely an edge-cancellation argument, so the four subtriangles and paired orientations are precisely the mathematical content a diagram could verify.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw ordered outer triangle a→b→c→a, midpoints p on ab, q on bc, r on ca; shade/label triangles [a,p,r], [p,b,q], [r,q,c], [p,q,r] with their listed orientations. Mark p↔r, q↔p, r↔q as canceling interior edge pairs.
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain editorial candidate; source claims are explicit and coherent.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: The endpoint-fixed homotopy H:[0,1]²→Ω is subdivided into cells Q_jk; each cell boundary maps to a polygon, interior edges cancel, and bottom/top polygonal paths recover γ0 and γ1 integrals.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: parameter-square grid and mapped boundary orientations
diagram_candidates.reason: The proof uses the square grid and edge cancellation across adjacent cells; a compact diagram would make the bottom/top path orientation and fixed side edges easy to verify.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: Draw [0,1]² with horizontal edges s↦γ0(s), γ1(s), vertical sides constant, an N×N grid, one cell Q_jk labeled a,b,c,d in boundary order, and opposite arrows on a shared edge. Keep distinction between parameter-square edges and mapped polygonal edges.
diagram_candidates.certainty: uncertain editorial candidate; based on the stated homotopy and proof construction.
